question: Which Union Minister officially announced that the Khelo India University Games 2025 will be held in Rajasthan this November?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mansukh Mandaviya**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
__ 

• **Mansukh Mandaviya**, the Union Minister of Health and Family Welfare, officially announced that the **Khelo India University Games 2025** will be held in **Rajasthan** this November. 

• The announcement showcases the government's commitment to promoting **sports culture** and providing a platform for young talent to showcase their skills. 

• The **Khelo India University Games** is a part of the **Khelo India initiative**, which aims to nurture grassroots sports talent and provide opportunities for young athletes. 

• The decision to host the event in Rajasthan is significant as it highlights the state's growing role in **sports development** and infrastructure. 

• The event will witness the participation of university athletes from across the country, promoting **unity and sportsmanship**. 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 
 

• **Khelo India Initiative:** 
 

• The **Khelo India Programme** was launched by the Government of India in **2018** to revive the sports culture in the country. 

• It aims to promote mass participation in sports and identify and nurture sports talent at the grassroots level. 

• Under the initiative, athletes are provided with financial assistance of **Rs. 5 lakhs per annum** for training and development. 
 
 

• **Previous Khelo India University Games:** 
 

• The inaugural edition of the Khelo India University Games was held in **Bhubaneswar, Odisha**, in **2020**. 

• The second edition was hosted by **Bengaluru, Karnataka**, in **2022**. 

• The games aim to bring together university athletes from all over the country and showcase their sporting prowess. 
 
 

• **Rajasthan's Role in Sports:** 
 

• Rajasthan has been actively developing its sports infrastructure, including stadiums and training facilities, to promote sports culture in the state. 

• The state has hosted several national and international sporting events, contributing to its reputation as an emerging sports hub in India. 
 
 

• **Significance of Khelo India University Games:** 
 

• The games provide an important platform for young athletes to gain exposure and experience at a competitive level. 

• They contribute to the identification of talent for national and international competitions, including the **Olympics** and **Commonwealth Games**. 

• The event also fosters **unity and cultural exchange** among participants from different parts of the country.
